Assuming arithmetic would give \(d=\frac{8-5}{5-3}=\frac32\). Then  
\[
a_n=5+\frac32(n-3)=\frac{3n+1}{2}.
\]
The condition \(a_n+a_{n+1}+a_{n+2}=7\) gives \(3a_n+3d=7\), so
\[
a_n=\frac{5}{6}.
\]
Thus
\[
\frac{3n+1}{2}=\frac56 \implies 9n+3=5 \implies n=\frac29,
\]
not a positive integer. So the sequence cannot be arithmetic, and no other defining rule is given. Therefore \(a_{2005}\) is not determined.

\[
\boxed{\text{cannot be determined}}
\]
